analysis: No verified fills yet — the strategy has proposed trades but none filled inside displayed depth and limits (see its intents), or its trigger conditions have not met on the captured universe.

evidence.claim: Favourite-longshot bias is documented across parimutuel and prediction markets; a CEPR/VoxEU column analyses 300k+ Kalshi contracts specifically.
Kalshi quadratic taker fee 0.07*C*P*(1-P) applied to every fill in the ledger.

failure_mode: Every settled upset costs nearly the whole stake; a run of upsets erases many wins. Fees on high-volume favourites are also the largest in absolute dollars.
name: Heavy Favourite Holder
rule: On an active universe market with volume >= 10,000 contracts, buy the side whose ask is between 0.85 and 0.97 and whose displayed spread is <= 4c, sizing 25% of cash, and hold to the official settlement.
why: Favourite-longshot bias: the over-bought side is the longshot, so heavy favourites are (if the bias exists) slightly under-priced and pay a small, repeatable edge at settlement. No exit logic: the trade is the settlement.
